intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 (MRT37) is caused by homozygous mutation in the ANK3 gene (600465) on chromosome 10q21.2.

checks.claim: Autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 (MRT37) is caused by homozygous mutation in the ANK3 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems, we identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the same gene
checks.explanation: Abstract reports homozygous ANK3 mutation in a consanguineous ID family but does not name MRT37 or explicitly state autosomal recessive inheritance.

checks.claim: The ANK3 gene is located on chromosome 10q21.2.
checks.evidence_quote: AnkyrinG, encoded by the ANK3 gene, is involved in neuronal development and signaling.
checks.explanation: Chromosomal location is standard nomenclature restating the gene; not in abstract itself.

paragraphs.text: In affected members of a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability, an ADHD-like phenotype, and behavioral problems, Iqbal et al. (2013) identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the ANK3 gene. Iqbal et al. (2013) stated that this was the first reported familial mutation in the ANK3 gene. Memory defects in a Drosophila knockdown model of the ANK3 ortholog supported causality of the ANK3 mutation.

paragraphs.text: In the same report, Iqbal et al. (2013) described an unrelated patient with borderline intelligence, severe ADHD, autism, and sleeping problems in whom all isoforms of the ANK3 gene were disrupted by a balanced translocation, a heterozygous disruption of the gene.
